data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was GBP 26.778m. The reporting year saw an overall small favourable prior year development: the Managing Agent states an overall surplus of GBP 0.7m on prior year reserves in 2016, primarily driven by better-than-expected claims experience in the casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes. No reliable aggregate GROSS prior year movement (insurance-liabilities column) is presented in the accounts notes in an unambiguous way, so a gross PYD figure could not be extracted from the published tables.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2016, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 0.7m on prior year reserves (2015:surplus GBP 1.2m). This has been primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes of business.
data.data_quality_notes: A gross aggregate prior year development (Insurance liabilities column) was not explicitly provided in the notes. The report contains an explicit narrative stating a net prior year surplus of GBP 0.7m (page 36) but that figure appears to be net of reinsurance. A gross claims development triangle was not clearly available in the gross amounts (only net triangle/data shown). Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null to avoid reporting a net figure as gross. Named catastrophe scenario exposures and gross/net outstanding balances were extractable.
